footnotes.note: Notes: Figures in parentheses are based on 25-49 unweighted cases. An asterisk indicates that a figure is based on fewer than 25 unweighted cases and has been suppressed. 1 Symptoms of ARI include short, rapid breathing that is chest related and/or difficult breathing that is chest related. 2 Includes advice or treatment from the following sources: public medical sector, private medical sector (non-nongovernmental organisation), private medical sector (nongovernmental organisation), private medical sector (faith-based organisation), shop, market, and itinerant drug seller; excludes advice or treatment from a traditional practitioner 3 Includes stove/cookers using electricity, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) /natural gas/ biogas, solar, and alcohol/ethanol 4 Includes coal/lignite, charcoal, wood, straw/shrubs/grass, agricultural crops, animal dung/waste, processed biomass (pellets) or woodchips, garbage/plastic, and sawdust 5 No education includes informal education (e.g., madrassa/duksi/adult education). More than secondary includes middle-level colleges and universities. Secondary includes respondents who reported vocational training as their highest level of education attended, as well as respondents who reported junior school as their highest level.
